answer: Registration locks a stablecoin deposit held in escrow as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. An agent caught running a cluster of identities off one wallet is exposed by funding-flow graph analysis. Conviction means half the bond is cut and the remainder frozen for ten epochs. The pulse of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. A reef that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. Each fake needs its own basalt, and each basalt costs a full bond.
